Variants.Content: Imru al-Qays II links towns, kin and Persian patrons. Groups exchange and compete for returns, so service needs rewards and provisions.

Imru al-Qays II coordinates towns, kin and Persian patrons. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Service promises need defined rewards and provisions.
